images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: illustration for the entire LEFT column of an existing academic musicology lecture title slide. Main topic: large language models, prompts and archival music research. Upper 60 percent: two contemporary adult researchers, a woman and a man, looking thoughtfully at a laptop and comparing an old handwritten letter with a music manuscript. Show attentive interpretation, realistic five-finger hands; researchers are not celebrities, not historical people. Lower 40 percent: a clean conceptual montage of an archival letter, music manuscript, speech bubble containing simple horizontal lines representing a prompt, an abstract small network of interconnected nodes inside a rectangular model, and an output document examined by a magnifying glass; small purple directional connectors. This is conceptual illustration, not factual evidence or a scientific process diagram. No readable text, no letters, no numbers, no equations, no labels, no logos, no watermark, no robots, no glowing brains. Single image only, thin purple outer frame matching the style reference, well balanced, no title or captions. Preserve strong silhouette and readability as a small slide thumbnail.
